description:
GET /v1/account/terms response: the caller's acceptance of the router terms.

`accepted` says whether the caller accepted `current_version`, and `accepted_at`
is when (null when not). `last_accepted_version` is the most recent version the
caller ever accepted (null when never), so a client can tell a first acceptance
from a re-acceptance after a new version.

`must_accept_by` is set while the caller is in the grace period of a new version:
they accepted an earlier version, and the newer ones are not enforced
yet. It is the date (00:00 UTC) from which they are refused until they accept
`current_version`. Null when `accepted` is true and when there is no grace.
title: TermsStatusOut
